summary.title: Shift Summary
tutorial.first_clockin.title: Shift Started
tutorial.first_clockin.body: You're on the clock! Head to the pickup point to load packages into your van, or collect a mail bag from the post box.
tutorial.first_loading.title: Loading Packages
tutorial.first_loading.body: Pick up boxes from the pallet and load them into the back of your van. All packages must be loaded before you can start delivering.
tutorial.first_delivery_start.title: Deliveries Ready
tutorial.first_delivery_start.body: Follow the GPS to each delivery point. Hold H to see a floating waypoint above your destination. Watch the timer!
tutorial.first_delivery_complete.title: Delivery Complete
tutorial.first_delivery_complete.body: Nice work! Your earnings accumulate during your shift and are paid to your bank when you clock out.
tutorial.first_timer_expired.title: Timer Expired
tutorial.first_timer_expired.body: You ran over time! Late deliveries reduce your pay by 15%. Try to deliver before the timer runs out for full earnings.
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.title: Vehicle Destroyed
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.body: Your delivery van was destroyed! You've been fined and received a complaint. Too many complaints leads to suspension.
tutorial.first_level_up.title: Level Up!
tutorial.first_level_up.body: You've been promoted! Higher levels unlock more packages per batch, clustered routes, and better pay multipliers.
tutorial.first_batch_complete.title: Batch Complete
tutorial.first_batch_complete.body: All deliveries done! Return to the supervisor to request a new task, or clock out to receive your shift payout.
tutorial.first_crew.title: Crew Partner
tutorial.first_crew.body: A partner joined your crew! You'll share deliveries and earn a co-op bonus on each completed delivery.
